commands.name: search
commands.detail: Filter events or transformed rows.

commands.name: where
commands.detail: Filter with comparisons, including null-propagating period concatenation such as first." ".last = full_name for String and number operands (use tostring(value) for Boolean), direct isnull/isnotnull predicates, match(value, "regex") substring predicates using a literal bounded RE2 pattern, like(value, "pattern") whole-string predicates using a literal bounded wildcard pattern, now() as the fixed search-start Unix second, relative_time(time, "specifier") as nullable Unix seconds after a bounded literal offset-and-snap program in the effective IANA search timezone, strftime(time, "format") in that timezone, or strptime(text, "format") as nullable Unix seconds.

commands.name: eval
commands.detail: Create or replace fields; the null-propagating period operator concatenates 2-32 String or number operands in source order, as in full_name=first." ".last (use tostring(value) for Boolean), if(predicate, true_value, false_value) selects between two values, coalesce(value, fallback, ...) selects the first non-null fixed value, case(predicate, value, ...) selects the value for the first true predicate, lower(value)/upper(value) map a Unicode string or multivalue, len(value)/length(value) count UTF-8 code points in one string, substr(value, start[, length]) selects UTF-8 code points with SQLite indexing and literal integer indexes, tostring(value) preserves strings, renders exact numbers, and uses capitalized Boolean text, round(value[, precision]) rounds a number with an optional literal precision from 0 through 18, ceil(value)/ceiling(value) rounds a number upward, floor(value) rounds it downward, mvcount(value) counts non-null multivalue members, a single value as 1, and no values as null, mvsort(multivalue_field) sorts homogeneous String members in ascending encoded order while preserving duplicates, match(value, "regex") tests substring matches with a 4 KiB literal RE2 pattern, like(value, "pattern") tests whole-string matches with a 4 KiB literal wildcard pattern where % matches zero or more Unicode code points and _ matches one Unicode code point, now() returns the fixed search-start Unix second, relative_time(time, "-1d@d+2h") applies an optional signed offset, optional snap, and optional signed post-snap offset in the effective IANA search timezone and returns nullable Unix seconds from a 1 KiB literal specifier, strftime(time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%Q") formats canonical time or Unix seconds in that timezone using a bounded literal format, and strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N") requires a full date and returns nullable microsecond Unix seconds with a 4 KiB literal format and a 4 KiB String input ceiling. Formatted tostring modes and negative or calculated round precisions are not yet supported.

commands.name: head

commands.name: tail
commands.detail: Keep and reverse the final rows.

commands.name: regex
commands.detail: Filter one exact field with a bounded literal RE2 pattern.

commands.name: reverse
commands.detail: Reverse the established deterministic pipeline order.

commands.name: accum
commands.detail: Add a bounded running numeric sum in pipeline order.

commands.name: strcat

commands.name: addinfo

commands.name: fillnull

commands.name: addtotals

commands.name: nomv

commands.name: stats
commands.insertion: stats partitions=1 allnum=false delim="," count AS events sparkline(avg(latency),5m) AS latency_trend values(user) AS users rate(bytes) AS byte_rate BY level dedup_splitvals=false
commands.detail: Aggregate with bounded row, predicate, field, distinct-count, percentile, distribution, value-selection, chronological, rate, and time-binned sparkline measures. Leading unsigned partitions (0 selects the default; values above 100 clamp to 100), allnum, and delim options plus terminal dedup_splitvals are preserved in the plan; delimiter-display and parallel-order details remain oracle-governed.

commands.name: eventstats
commands.insertion: eventstats values(user) AS users BY service
commands.detail: Add one row count, field-occurrence count, true-only count(eval(predicate)), exact distinct count, bounded canonical distinct-values list, bounded order-preserving list, pN/percN percentile (1-99), numeric sum, numeric average, exact mixed-type minimum, exact mixed-type maximum, chronologically earliest, or chronologically latest value to every input row globally or within up to 16 exact BY fields.

commands.name: streamstats
commands.detail: Add one bounded running row count, exact-field occurrence count, true-only count(eval(predicate)), numeric sum, numeric average, exact mixed-type minimum, exact mixed-type maximum, or chronological earliest/latest value over deterministic pipeline frames; chronological winners use immutable event order. Options support excluding the current row and partitioning frames by exact fields.

commands.name: top

commands.name: rare

commands.name: timechart
commands.detail: Chart row counts, field occurrence counts, percentiles, sums, or averages over fixed time buckets; every supported aggregate may split BY one field.

commands.name: chart
commands.insertion: chart count OVER status BY level
commands.detail: Build a bounded two-dimensional pivot of row counts, exact-field occurrence counts, percentiles, sums, or averages.
